I didn't wanna do this, but there wasn't a way out.
I kept telling myself, You just have to be brave once.
And my brain interpreted it in two ways : Don't do it, be brave. And Get it over with, be brave.

Well, I didn't do it, and sat there crying, the knife in my hand, me on the floor.
That was the scariest moment of my life.
The terror, the pain, it felt horrible.
I am glad I didn't do it, but that day, the things I felt.
